decision.lookahead: Retained after corrected-harness throughput and small/mixed controls; see corrected-harness evidence. No strict p99 bound is certified.
decision.prefix_packing: Rejected. Reduced write calls, but regressed TCP runtime; combined packing plus lookahead also lost to lookahead alone.

method.latency_gate: Reject a reproducible >5% p99 regression; noisy observations do not establish a strict non-inferiority bound.
method.transport_scope: TCP loopback or bounded 64KiB in-memory duplex; not a service or network-path benchmark
